preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.

exploit_hint: The contract owner can call any of the fee-setting functions, such as `setSellTaxFeePercent`, `setBuyLiquidityFeePercent`, or `setSelldevFeePercent`, with an arbitrarily high value. To trigger the vulnerability, call `setSellTaxFeePercent(99)` as the owner to set the selling tax to 99%, which severely impacts a user's ability to sell their tokens.
